categories.name: Any%
categories.rules:
Any% no restrictions.

Runs below 20:00 require video, runs slower than this limit without video may be treated with suspicion.

Timing starts from file select. (+0:00 from new game, +1:56.25 from 0 star file on DS, +1:55.40 from 0 star file on VC.)
Timing ends when the big star is collected at the end of the game.

14 seconds will be added onto WiiUVC runs because they have faster loads than DS.

categories.name: 8 Star
categories.rules:
Any% no 8 star door skip and 2nd key door skip.

Runs below 25:00 require video, runs slower than this limit without video may be treated with suspicion.

Timing starts from file select. (+0:00 from new game, +1:56.25 from 0 star file on DS, +1:55.40 from 0 star file on VC.)
Timing ends when the big star is collected at the end of the game.

25 seconds will be added onto WiiUVC runs because they have faster loads than DS.

categories.name: 50 Star
categories.rules:
Any% no rabbit clips and 2nd key door skip. Other major skips such as the endless stairs skip and moat skip are allowed.

Runs below 50:00 require video, runs slower than this limit without video may be treated with suspicion.

Timing starts from file select. (+0:00 from new game, +1:56.25 from 0 star file on DS, +1:55.40 from 0 star file on VC.)
Timing ends when the big star is collected at the end of the game.

1 minute and 13 seconds will be added onto WiiUVC runs because they have faster loads than DS.

categories.name: 80 Star
categories.rules:
Any% No Major Skips (Intended Any%). Rabbit clips, moat skip, endless stairs skip,  and overworld OoB (out of bounds) are all banned. Stage OoB is allowed.

Runs below 1:20:00 require video, runs slower than this limit without video may be treated with suspicion.

Timing starts from file select. (+0:00 from new game, +1:56.25 from 0 star file on DS, +1:55.40 from 0 star file on VC.)
Timing ends when the big star is collected at the end of the game.

1 minute and 58 seconds (or 2m05s for Luigi route) will be added onto WiiUVC runs because they have faster loads than DS.

categories.name: 150 Star
categories.rules:
100%. No restrictions. Mini-game rabbits are not required.

Runs below 3:15:00 require video, runs slower than this limit without video may be treated with suspicion.

Timing starts from file select. (+0:00 from new game, +1:56.25 from 0 star file on DS, +1:55.40 from 0 star file on VC.)
Timing ends when the big star is collected at the end of the game.

3 minutes and 55 seconds will be added onto WiiUVC runs because they have faster loads than DS.

categories.name: Yoshi
categories.rules:
Timing starts on level fade in and ends upon touching the star (When the star is first above the character's head.)

For this category, enter your time under "Load Removed Time", and leave "Real Time Attack" blank.

For runs being submitted under the Mario, Luigi or Wario categories, you must be playing as that character when you enter the level.

For runs under the Yoshi category, selecting a cap from the star select screen is allowed, but not always the best option, e.g. for shorter stars you will usually want to stay as Yoshi.

Whatever character you are playing as, once within the level you may collect caps as you please. This will not affect which category you are submitting to.

runList.comment:
Back in August, I was intent on getting Any% WR, but I fell short and had to focus on school. Now starting on the 21st I picked up this game again and managed to achieve this before the year ended.  Regarding each split, SSL and Mario were pretty solid, 2KDS setup was like a second off my best in practice so it's alright, BitS Entry was good besides the ledge grab that lost .5, and BitS was good with the strats I went for. I might keep grinding with the addition of TJWK in BitS for the sub 9:30 after I get the 5/5 main category sweep

Special thanks to bobbybob for helping me learn 2KDS

9:58.15(Race File)

Lost 4s(8s from TJWK strat) on BitS.
But not bad run overall.
1 step closer to the fabled new 3ds 5/5 (10:46.95 I'm pretty sure)
Very bad basement rabbit, pretty bad bowser fight. BITS TJWK was cool though. Sub 11 soon!

Got both rabbit clips first try which I'm very happy about, considering two weeks ago I was struggling immensely trying to get them at all... 
Very hype PB and I'm glad people were there to see it
3rd try basement rabbit clip and missed throw. Pretty happy with this run and probably won't touch this category again for a while
Apart from one missed Bowser throw and a few sloppy movements, I'm very glad of this run !

~12:44.867
only missed the triple jump in fire sea. Everything else was good
long time no see pb update

First try both rabbit grabs and clips
Piano's signature BitS™
1st time actually completing this category may decide to  improve may not...

Runner note: resubmitted to replace Twitch highlight with YouTube upload, also finally fixed the fact this didn't have its own dedicated video

Part of a Super Mario Handheld Series run that starts with this game.

Sub 18 Poggers :) Took me a while to finally get a run done again and apparently I just needed to PB 4Head
Pretty interesting run... death to Goomboss, horrible fire sea, one missed throw, and a lot of trouble with rabbit clips.  Didn't record, but I'm attaching splits as proof of this time.
My recording soft ware stopped working for some reason but the rules said that we dont need to have a video unless its sub 20 so yeah.
bad run but I don't even run this game so I'll take it
